description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for configuration parsing in the lighttpd server project. It declares functions for parsing configuration files and snippets, as well as error handling related to configuration.

methods.name: li_config_error_quark
methods.description: Returns a GQuark object representing the error domain for configuration errors.

methods.name: li_config_parse
methods.description: Parses the main configuration file for the lighttpd server, returning success or failure.

methods.name: li_config_parse_live
methods.description: Parses a configuration snippet at runtime, not supporting includes or global variable modifications.
